 "rationale": "A PNP/NMOS level-shift bandgap needs Veb+Vgs+Vsg ≈ 2.4 V when cold, so it cannot work at 1.62 V. A beta-multiplier only needs Vsg_p + ~0.6 V. Output branch: PTAT current I into R3 in parallel with (R2+PNP), so vref = R3/(R2+R3)*(Veb+I*R2) ≈ 0.85 V. With I≈0.4 uA per branch and a ~0.2 uA start-up load, total current is about 1.4 uA, giving roughly 2.8 uW at 1.98 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "Rs":   (182e3, 80e3, 500e3),    # beta-multiplier source resistor (sets PTAT current)
    "R2":   (1.43e6, 0.6e6, 3e6),    # PTAT-to-voltage resistor in output branch
    "R3":   (3.3e6, 1.5e6, 8e6),     # output shunt resistor (scales bandgap to ~0.85 V)
    "W1":   (4.0, 1.0, 16.0),        # NMOS core width (um)
    "L1":   (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),         # NMOS core length
    "K":    (8, 4, 16),              # M2 multiplicity (ln K sets PTAT)
    "Wp":   (4.0, 1.0, 16.0),        # PMOS mirror width
    "Lp":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # PMOS mirror length (high rout -> line reg/PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    Rs, R2, R3 = p["Rs"], p["R2"], p["R3"]
    W1, L1, Wp, Lp = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["Wp"], p["Lp"]
    K = int(round(p["K"]))

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # --- PMOS mirror (M4 diode on branch b) ---
    n.M("M3", "a", "b", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "b", "b", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # --- NMOS beta-multiplier: M1 diode, M2 = K x M1 with source degeneration Rs ---
    n.M("M1", "a", "a", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "b", "a", "s2", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=K)
    n.R("Rs", "s2", "vss", Rs)
    # --- output branch: PTAT current into R3 || (R2 + PNP) ---
    n.M("M5", "vref", "b", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # --- start-up: weak PMOS load pulls st high when a is low; MS pulls b low ---
    n.M("MPL1", "x1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MPL2", "st", "vss", "x1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS2", "st", "a", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4 * W1, L1)
    n.M("MS", "b", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    # --- first-order predictions ---
    nsub = 1.35
    vptat_core = nsub * UT * math.log(K)          # Vgs1 - Vgs2 ~ n*UT*lnK
    I = vptat_core / Rs
    vptat = I * R2
    # solve vref = R3/(R2+R3)*(Veb+I*R2) with Veb at the PNP current (fixed-point)
    vref = 0.85
    for _ in range(20):
        iq = max((vref - 0.6) / R2, 1e-9)
        veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(iq / 10e-6)
        vref = R3 / (R2 + R3) * (veb + vptat)
    # TC: Veb slope ~ -1.9 mV/C at low current; PTAT slope = vptat/300K
    slope = R3 / (R2 + R3) * (-1.9e-3 + vptat / 300.0)
    tc_ppm = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 150    # +curvature allowance
    i_start = 0.2e-6
    itot = 3 * I + i_start
    power = itot * 1.98
    line_reg = 0.02                            # long-L PMOS mirror, V/V
    psrr_1k = 30.0
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc_ppm, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr_1k, "startup_ok": 1}
